headline_status: READY for ultra-early cancer signaling at the open-data + in-silico panel-LLR level. Clinical-grade evidence requires real plasma validation (see ULTRA_EARLY_READINESS.md §4).

checks.name: cross_study_pooled_auc_gc_corrected
checks.description: FinaleDB pubs 6+8 cross-study pooled AUC with GC/maptaxia correction (5-channel fragmentomics).
checks.notes: AUC 0.9684 ± 0.0027 across 5 seeds × 5 folds. True-confound control collapsed to 0.4836 (signal IS cancer-vs-healthy, not batch). See open-data cross-publication benchmark on FinaleDB publications: ['6', '8'] (['jiang', 'cristiano']). NOT clinical validation. NOT external cohort validation. Pooled OOF on the same cohort that trained the model.

checks.name: panel_llr_ultra_low_vaf_0_1pct
checks.description: Panel-LLR AUC at 0.1% ctDNA on the TCGA-LUAD panel. Production-spec readout (50k× depth + ≤1e-4 error).

checks.name: foundation_fusion_layer
checks.description: Stage-1 multi-modal fusion layer vs the LR baseline, on paired TCGA-LUAD (n=40 samples / 20 patients, per-patient GroupKFold).
checks.notes: regularized_late_fusion 0.9825 vs LR baseline 0.9042 (same run, same folds). The neural foundation encoder scores 0.554 +/- 0.005 on this cohort -- it overfits a cohort of this size, so the fix is a smaller late-fusion estimator rather than a better encoder. Permuted-label null measured at ~0.42 (NOT 0.5) on this paired design; see scripts/fusion_regularized_smoke.py. n=40 simulated plasma, one cancer type -- an estimator-class result, not a clinical one.

checks.name: stage_breakdown_capability
checks.description: Per-cancer sens@spec broken down by Stage I vs LATE vs UNKNOWN. New build_stage_breakdown_table function exercised by tests + synthetic smoke.
checks.threshold: returns a populated per_stage breakdown on any input TSV with a 'stage' column
checks.notes: Open-data FinaleDB cohort has no stage labels — the stage breakdown is wired up but not populated for the current headline. See ULTRA_EARLY_READINESS.md §1.3.
